title: Failed invoice rate, 2024
prompt: Billing wants to know: what share of invoices issued in 2024 failed?
metricDefinition: failed invoices / total invoices, for invoices issued in 2024.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::DOUBLE / count(*) AS failed_rate FROM invoices WHERE issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
